all_reforms_including_excluded.description: The federal budget introduced a Special Recovery Program aimed at boosting private fixed investment through enhanced investment tax credits and the establishment of Special Recovery Funds for investment and export financing.
all_reforms_including_excluded.growth_orientation_rationale: The program is designed to stimulate private investment, which can lead to increased productivity and economic growth.
all_reforms_including_excluded.status_evidence: The budget confirmed the introduction of the Special Recovery Program.
all_reforms_including_excluded.importance_rationale: This program represents a significant structural change in the approach to stimulating private investment, which is crucial for economic recovery and growth.
all_reforms_including_excluded.source_quote: The federal budget provides for incentives to boost private fixed investment through enhancement of investment tax credits, introduction of share-purchase tax credit and establishment of Special Recovery Funds for investment and export financing.
all_reforms_including_excluded.cross_verification_note: The description focuses on 'boosting private fixed investment through enhanced investment tax credits' and 'Special Recovery Funds for investment and export financing', which does not directly relate to R&D funding or knowledge transfer.

all_reforms_including_excluded.description: The federal government announced R&D and technology promotion incentives in 1983 as part of a medium-term Special Recovery Program. These included enhancement of investment tax credits, establishment of Special Recovery Funds, and draft amendments to the Income Tax Act to stimulate private R&D activity.
all_reforms_including_excluded.growth_orientation_rationale: Investment tax credits and R&D incentives reduce the cost of capital for private innovation, encouraging firms to increase R&D spending and modernization, which supports productivity growth.
all_reforms_including_excluded.status_evidence: Announced in federal budget and October 1983; draft amendments proposed but implementation status unclear.
all_reforms_including_excluded.importance_rationale: Significant policy initiative targeting private R&D through multiple instruments (tax credits, recovery funds, legislative amendments), but narrower in scope than a system-wide restructuring.
all_reforms_including_excluded.source_quote: Promotion of technology and RAD expenditure. ... incentives to boost private fixed investment (also costed at $2.4 billion) through enhancement of investment tax credits, introduction of share-purchase tax credit and establishment of Special Recovery Funds for investment and export financing.
all_reforms_including_excluded.cross_verification_note: The reform mentions 'enhancement of investment tax credits' and 'Special Recovery Funds', which primarily aim at boosting private fixed investment rather than directly supporting R&D activities.

all_reforms_including_excluded.description: Canada replaced seven previous industrial, regional and trade development schemes with a single Industrial and Regional Development Program (IRDP) to rationalize administration and enhance available benefits and geographic coverage. The program provides assistance for modernization, new product/process development, industrial restructuring, infrastructure establishment, and market research.
all_reforms_including_excluded.growth_orientation_rationale: Consolidation of seven schemes into one program reduces administrative complexity and expands geographic coverage and available benefits, improving allocative efficiency and incentivizing private investment in modernization and new product/process development.
all_reforms_including_excluded.status_evidence: Text states program is implemented (replaced seven previous schemes), but specific implementation year not provided in source.
all_reforms_including_excluded.importance_rationale: Structural reform consolidating seven separate development schemes into a single program represents a system-wide rationalization of industrial and regional development policy.
all_reforms_including_excluded.source_quote: Seven previous industrial, regional and trade development schemes have now been replaced by a single Industrial and Regional Development Program, with a view to rationalising administration as well as enhancing available benefits and their geographic coverage.
all_reforms_including_excluded.cross_verification_note: The program focuses on 'modernization, new product/process development, industrial restructuring, infrastructure establishment, and market research', which does not clearly indicate a primary purpose related to R&D funding or knowledge transfer.
